claims.text: The USA spends 81.5% of its GDP on consumption.
Final consumption expenditure is expenditure on goods and services by resident institutional units for the direct satisfaction of human needs or wants.
claims.support: Final consumption expenditure is expenditure on goods and services by resident institutional units for the direct satisfaction of human needs or wants, whether individual or collective.
